intro.m2: This is a game Hector made for you!

instructions.m1: You have {{seconds}} seconds to answer each question
instructions.m2: for every correct answer you'll win a heart
instructions.m3: for every wrong answer you'll accumulate one of the 4 possible punishments:

menu.groupLocked: You already finished this group. Reset the game in settings to play it again.
menu.lockedCreate: Finish the 3 question groups to create your own quiz
menu.lockedResults: Finish the 3 question groups to see the summary
menu.lockedPhoto: Finish the 3 question groups to take a photo
menu.lockedModel: Finish the 3 question groups to see the model
menu.lockedGift: Finish the 3 question groups to see your gift

celebrate.hint: Look behind the photo with our padlock on the Münster bridge

pin.title: Enter the code
pin.tip: Tip: Look behind the photo with the lotus flower in the album

play.resumed: Picking up where you left off

bonus.hint: Tap the map to drop your marker, then press Accept
bonus.noScore: This question doesn't count towards hearts or punishments, and there's no time limit.
bonus.resultKm: Your marker landed {{km}} km from the right spot
bonus.giftPrompt: Imagine that "someone" turns 30 on 14 November. What gift would that "someone" like?

results.title: Answers
results.pick: Pick a group to see the details
results.cleared: Answers were hidden from this screen.

create.title: Create your quiz
create.incomplete: Fill in the question, all 3 answers, and mark one as correct.
create.notTranslated: This is saved exactly as you write it, with no translation.
create.overwriteConfirm: Are you sure? The previous questions will be deleted

photo.title: A photo to remember
photo.subtitle: Smile, this one goes in the collection
photo.caricatureFailed: We couldn't create the caricature, but your original photo is saved
photo.alreadyTaken: You already took your photo. You can enable another one from Settings.
photo.permissionDenied: We couldn't access the camera. Check your browser permissions.

summary.title: Now it's time to pay
summary.message: Now it's time to pay what you owe!

settings.title: Settings
settings.deleteAnswersDesc: Hides answers in the app and clears what's stored on this device. Database records are never deleted.
settings.resetPhotoDesc: Re-enables the photo screen without touching any progress.
settings.resetPhotoDone: The photo screen is available again.
settings.resetAllDesc: Clears hearts, punishments, completed groups and the saved quiz on this device.
settings.confirmErase: Are you sure you want to erase the whole process?
